title: S30 — v5: de-rotation-aware retrain + hard-arm budget (S29 iteration 2, diagnostics-driven)
desc: S29 left two named levers; the collage diagnostics are now in and they CHANGE the design: the probe's as-is crops are not 'rotation-hard' — ALL 12 adjacent per-char boxes OVERLAP after ±9 deg rotation (measured on every collage item; border-ink 3-23px on most crops = neighbor fragments; one crop clipped to empty). Tight per-char extraction from rotated text is fundamentally ambiguous — no CNN fixes that. So iteration 2 is: (1) de-rotation FIRST (S7b's card de-rotation exists) — train v5 on DE-ROTATED crops with residual ±2-3 deg jitter + heavy-stroke/pit augs; (2) hard-arm budget: per-class 600 on corroded/de-rotated distributions vs 311 baseline; (3) measure on S28 arms: success = de-rotated >= 0.85 (v4: 0.70, v3: 0.68) AND corroded >= 0.60 (v4: 0.44-0.52) — staged bar, honest if missed. Same seed discipline; v5 NOT shipping unless it beats v4 on both target arms without clean-val collapse below 0.90. Parent: t-20261011-88dc.
